correctness.rationale: The 13 independent checks (overall binary parity and two F64 field moments of exponents 1,5) leave dimension 64-13=51. The four points a+v F4 have vanishing zero, first and fifth moments because sum t=sum t^2=0 and t^4=t in F4. Every 4-point zero-syndrome set has form {a,a+s,c,c+s}; the fifth moment forces ((a+c)/s)^4=(a+c)/s and distinctness yields the two nontrivial subfield values. Exact independent GF64 arithmetic enumerated 336 distinct lines, checked all zero syndromes and rank 51 for their GF2 incidence vectors, and exhausted 336 weight-four solutions; so inclusion plus equal dimension yields equality. Earlier known line automorphism group is transferred, not rediscovered.
